snippet.title: Shards of the Banished - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
A dark fantasy adventure in development by students from Futuregames. 

Join our Community Discord for news and to be a part of the development! 

https://discord.gg/zBe2NZw7Nz

Trailer made in Unreal Engine 5 in 7 weeks. See full credits at the end.

Thank you for watching!
